metadata.title: ColorScripts-Enhanced
metadata.description: Displays the bundled ANSI-art colorscript collection with metadata filtering, localization, persistent configuration, and selective output caching for eligible renderers. Supports Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7+ on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
